review_evidence: README says the core artifact is a curated collection of qualifying-exam and research-level Lean theorem statements with necessary definitions.
Modules state formal versions of Schauder fixed point, Quillen–Suslin, Borsuk–Ulam, Green–Tao, Hilbert 17, Pontryagin duality, and other results.
The corpus policy counts reusable formal statements/interfaces as prior art, so benchmark status is not grounds for exclusion.
summary: Retain FormalQualBench: benchmark modules are themselves valuable formal theorem statements and supporting definitions, even where proofs are intentionally left as sorry.
